description:
Real Home Inspections. Real Problems. No Sugarcoating.

Texas Edge Home Inspections shares real home inspection videos from Houston, Texas—showing what’s actually wrong with houses before buyers move in.

We cover new construction defects, builder shortcuts, safety hazards, and hidden issues homeowners often miss. These are real inspections, broken down so you understand what matters and why it matters.

If you’re buying a home, building a house, or just want to know what inspectors really look for, you’re in the right place.

On this channel:
• New construction inspection defects
• Builder mistakes & poor workmanship
• Safety issues inspectors catch every day
• “It’s Not Supposed To Do That” real inspection finds
• Home maintenance & construction education

📍 Houston, TX
👷 Certified Master Inspector
📲 Follow for real inspections
